Class ModelInfoFile

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.model.ModelInfoFile
public final class ModelInfoFile extends Object
A model information file as the CQL translator writes it, read as it is: the model's own facts, the models it requires, its classes with their elements, its contexts, and its conversions, every attribute verbatim. A file is read by the schema's shape and may be validated against the schema first; the translator's own files are not, since they carry bindings without the value set the schema requires. Nothing is reworded; the one thing the reader adds is a qualified name for every type, the model's name and the class's name joined by a period, where a file writes the two apart.

The files bundled beside this class are the translator project's, under the Apache License 2.0; see the notice beside them (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1115).
